items.headline: Sources: Sean Payton to expand role in Broncos' playcalling process
items.description: The Broncos are taking a more collaborative playcalling approach this week with coach Sean Payton having an increased role in the process, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo.

items.headline: Broncos' Payton: Concerned about details, not playcalling
items.description: Sean Payton said righting the wrongs of Denver's offense is more about the "specific and the detail of each play," not who is actually calling the plays.
